notes: DRAFT for C3 (lore bible). Same shape as the 'guardian' and 'relics' entries in story/chapter-1.json (id, name, tier, description; relics add sensei). Added fields: tier.place, tier.form (the real belt form name from docs/curriculum.md), tier.clue (the mystery piece this tier reveals), guardian.freed and guardian.senseiAfter (one line each). The white tier's Guardian and Relics are copied unchanged from chapter-1.json. Text only; code is needed to show it.

tiers.clue: The light was not lost. It broke into pieces, and the pieces are still here.

guardian.name: The Lamp Keeper
guardian.description: Once it kept the Tower's first lamp lit. The shadow made it forget, but it never stopped hoping.
guardian.freed: A spark... I had forgotten how warm it feels.
guardian.senseiAfter: Watch, wait, then answer. You did just that.

relics.name: Cracked Lamp Glass
relics.description: A curved piece of glass, still warm. It came from something very big and very bright.
relics.sensei: Something this warm was never meant to stay in the dark.

relics.name: Faded Map
relics.description: An old map of the Tower. Someone circled the very top floor.
relics.sensei: Someone else climbed before you. You are not alone on this path.

relics.name: Little Wick
relics.description: A tiny wick, still glowing. Even a small light can fill a dark room.
relics.sensei: A small light still matters. So do you.

tiers.clue: The pieces of light fell in a circle around the Tower. Someone was standing in the middle, trying to catch them.

guardian.name: The Sun Gardener
guardian.description: A tall, gentle gardener made of vines. The shadow wrapped it in thorns, but its roots still reach for the sun.
guardian.freed: The thorns are gone. My flowers can open again.
guardian.senseiAfter: You moved light on your feet. The garden noticed.

relics.name: Sunrise Seed
relics.description: A seed that glows at dawn. It grew near the light for a long time.
relics.sensei: Good things grow slowly. So does skill.

relics.name: Bent Gate Key
relics.description: Captain Clank's old key. It was bent the night the light broke.
relics.sensei: Even a bent key can still open a door.

relics.name: Glowing Petal
relics.description: A petal that fell upward. It points to the top of the Tower.
relics.sensei: The light is calling you home.

tiers.clue: The night the storm came, one student left supper and ran up the Tower to help.

guardian.name: The Hearth Cook
guardian.description: A big, round cook with a ladle. The shadow made it guard the cold ovens alone.
guardian.freed: Is it supper time? I would love some company.
guardian.senseiAfter: You kept going, one step at a time.

relics.name: Empty Bowl
relics.description: A bowl with a name scratched off. Someone left before supper.
relics.sensei: A table is warmer when everyone is welcome.

relics.name: Cold Ember
relics.description: It glows faintly when you hold it close. Warmth was here once.
relics.sensei: Warmth comes back when we share it.

relics.name: Old Recipe Card
relics.description: "Soup for everyone. Save a bowl for the one who is late."
relics.sensei: Someone was always remembered here.

tiers.clue: The shadow is not one monster. It is made of many little fears, all stacked together.

guardian.name: The Stone Giant
guardian.description: Very tall and very loud. Inside, it is only a pile of stones the shadow stacked up.
guardian.freed: I was only stones and worry. Thank you for not running away.
guardian.senseiAfter: Big things can still fall to a brave, small heart.

relics.name: Smooth River Stone
relics.description: A small, smooth stone. It fits perfectly in your hand.
relics.sensei: Small and ready is enough.

relics.name: Little Water Jar
relics.description: A helper's jar, still half full. They kept carrying water after dark.
relics.sensei: Faithful work matters, even when no one sees.

relics.name: Pebble of Worry
relics.description: It looks heavy. It is light as air when you pick it up.
relics.sensei: Some worries are smaller than they look.

tiers.clue: A boat's log says one brave traveler carried the great light through the rain.

guardian.name: The River Watcher
guardian.description: A heron made of water. The shadow muddied its eyes, so it cannot see who is friend or foe.
guardian.freed: The water is clear. I can see you now, friend.
guardian.senseiAfter: You stayed calm in deep water.

relics.name: Boat Log Page
relics.description: "Tonight one traveler carried the light to keep it dry. The storm was coming."
relics.sensei: Helping can be very brave.

relics.name: Clear Drop
relics.description: A drop of water that never dries. You can see the stars inside it.
relics.sensei: Clear water shows the way.

relics.name: Worn Oar Handle
relics.description: Smooth from many hands rowing together.
relics.sensei: Many hands make the river easy.

tiers.clue: The traveler who carried the light wore red. Their shield kept the rain off it.

guardian.name: The Ember Knight
guardian.description: A knight of glowing metal. The shadow told it to protect the forge from everyone.
guardian.freed: I was guarding the wrong thing. Shields are for helping.
guardian.senseiAfter: Strength is best used to protect others.

relics.name: Cracked Red Shield
relics.description: A traveler's shield, cracked down the middle. They used it to cover the light.
relics.sensei: Even strong people need help sometimes.

relics.name: Forge Song Sheet
relics.description: The smiths' old song. It starts: "Strong hands, kind heart."
relics.sensei: Strong hands, kind heart.

relics.name: Cool Ember
relics.description: A coal that glows but does not burn you.
relics.sensei: Power can be gentle.

tiers.clue: The echoes told the traveler to give up. The traveler kept holding on.

guardian.name: The Echo Mask
guardian.description: A floating mask that copies your moves. Under the mask, it is lonely.
guardian.freed: I only copied what I heard. I would like to hear kind words now.
guardian.senseiAfter: You chose your own words, not the echo's.

relics.name: Traveler's Note
relics.description: "I will hold the light until help comes."
relics.sensei: Help is on the way.

relics.name: Kind Word Stone
relics.description: When you whisper to it, it whispers back: "You are loved."
relics.sensei: You are loved.

relics.name: Half Mask
relics.description: A mask cut in two. One side smiles.
relics.sensei: Be the same person inside and out.

tiers.clue: The last book has a page about the traveler. It says they were once a student of this very Tower.

guardian.name: The Root Keeper
guardian.description: A wise old tree who reads every book. The shadow made it forget how to share them.
guardian.freed: Take a book, little one. Your story belongs here too.

relics.name: Dusty Story Book
relics.description: A book of helpers. The last page is blank, waiting for a new story.
relics.sensei: Your story is still being written.

relics.name: Faded Student Sash
relics.description: An old practice sash with a name too faded to read.
relics.sensei: Every master was once a beginner.

relics.name: Root Ring
relics.description: A ring of wood that grows a little each time you read.
relics.sensei: Learning grows deep before it grows tall.

tiers.clue: The storm still spins at the top. The traveler is there, holding the last of the light.

guardian.name: The Storm Herald
guardian.description: A tall figure of wind and lightning. It shouts the storm louder so no one hears the calm.
guardian.freed: The wind is still. Listen. Someone is calling from the top.
guardian.senseiAfter: You stayed steady inside the storm.

relics.name: Calm Feather
relics.description: It floats still, even in the strongest wind.
relics.sensei: Peace can be inside you, even in a storm.

relics.name: Unsent Letter
relics.description: "I saved what I could. Please come help me finish."
relics.sensei: No one has to finish alone.

relics.name: Rainbow Shard
relics.description: A piece of the great light, shining every color.
relics.sensei: After the storm comes a promise.

tiers.clue: A storm broke the light, and a brave student tried to save it. No one is to blame. Together, you bring it home.

guardian.name: The Lost Lightbearer
guardian.description: The traveler, wrapped in storm clouds. They are tired from holding the last piece.
guardian.freed: You came all this way to help? Now we can finish together.
guardian.senseiAfter: Love brought the light home, and it brought them home too.

relics.name: The Great Lamp
relics.description: Every piece, together again. It shines on the whole town.
relics.sensei: The light was a gift, and gifts are meant to be shared.

relics.name: The Traveler's Sash
relics.description: The traveler's old sash, now clean. They want to train again.
relics.sensei: It is never too late to begin again.

relics.name: Summit Bell
relics.description: When it rings, the whole town hears it.
relics.sensei: Look how far you have come.
